intent: Display, and let a user select or remove, short chip-style values (e.g. active filters or multi-value entry).
avoid_when: values are read-only status labels rather than user-manipulable chips (use badges)
a11y_contract: built on React Aria TagGroup/Tag: keyboard navigation and selection/removal semantics come for free; the group requires a `label` prop, passed through as its aria-label
requires_data: a `label` describing the group of tags, and a list of tag values
